description:
Upgrade your ride with OEDRO Running Boards—where rugged durability meets sleek style. Designed for effortless access, they make getting in and out of your truck or Jeep a breeze while shielding your vehicle from road debris. With a bold, off-road-ready look and precision-built toughness, these running boards enhance safety, style, and convenience. Built to last and easy to maintain, they're the perfect upgrade for both adventurers and daily drivers.
Features
2-in-1 Recovery Design, Built for Adventure: Upgrade your truck with a unique combination of heavy-duty running boards and removable recovery traction boards. The integrated nylon traction boards are securely mounted on the steel step surface, providing a rugged off-road appearance while remaining compact and practical for unexpected recovery situations.
Removable Traction Boards for Emergency Recovery: Equipped with four independent nylon recovery boards (two for each side of the vehicle), the traction boards can be easily removed by loosening the fixed screws when extra traction is needed in mud, sand, snow, or uneven terrain. After recovery, simply reinstall them back onto the running boards.
Heavy-Duty Steel Construction with Long-Lasting Protection: Built with high-strength carbon steel, these running boards deliver excellent load-bearing capability and durability. The corrosion-resistant powder coating creates a protective barrier against rust, moisture, and harsh outdoor conditions, helping extend service life far beyond standard running boards.
No-Drill Bolt-On Installation, DIY Friendly: Designed for a direct bolt-on installation, these side steps mount securely using factory mounting points without drilling or vehicle modifications. The straightforward installation process allows most owners to complete the upgrade at home with basic tools.
Open Surface Design for Better Drainage & Durability: The unique hollow tread design improves water drainage and reduces the accumulation of mud, moisture, and corrosive liquids between the traction boards and the step surface. Regular cleaning helps maintain performance and significantly extends product lifespan.
3-Year Warranty | Professional installation is highly recommended for safety.
Fitment
Compatible with 2007-2018 Chevy Silverado 1500 Double Cab
